title: 0005 First-Run Polish: Parser Updates and Recipe-Detail UI Tweaks
description: Two-part polish spec from first-run testing. Part 1 (CookbookCore): swap >> metadata for YAML frontmatter between --- delimiters, swap == Name == section markers for = Name, flatten YAML list values to comma-separated strings, add the user's Pasta Bolognese as a canonical fixture, and update parser tests. Part 2 (CookbookApp): fix hero title clipping with a fixed-height container and bottom-leading overlay, remove the redundant bottom-bar scale picker, change the Add-to-menu icon to calendar, sentence-case ingredient and cookware names at display time, and make Recipes-list folder sections collapsible with in-memory state preserved across tab switches. The two parts share no source files and can be implemented in parallel.
